title: Group, Visa and Bespoke Reporting Charges Under the Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
Three services of the Corporate Travel Programmes are charged at their own published amounts rather than at a booking channel rate: a group booking handled by the group desk, the programme's visa and documentation service for one traveller, and a report built outside the standard reporting suite.

| Programme tier | Group booking handled by the group desk | Visa and documentation service, per traveller | Report built outside the standard suite |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 125.00 USD | 95.00 USD | 450.00 USD |
| Business Team Programme | 110.00 USD | 85.00 USD | 350.00 USD |
| Business Pro Programme | 95.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 250.00 USD |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 80.00 USD | 65.00 USD | 150.00 USD |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 65.00 USD | 55.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Business Global Programme | 50.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Notes

1. The group desk charge falls from 125.00 USD on the Business Starter Programme through 110.00 USD, 95.00 USD, 80.00 USD and 65.00 USD to 50.00 USD on the Business Global Programme.
2. The visa and documentation service is charged for each traveller: 95.00 USD, 85.00 USD, 75.00 USD, 65.00 USD and 55.00 USD across the first five tiers. On the Business Global Programme the published figure is 0.00 USD, so no charge is made for it.
3. A report built outside the standard suite is charged at 450.00 USD on the Business Starter Programme, 350.00 USD on the Business Team Programme, 250.00 USD on the Business Pro Programme and 150.00 USD on the Business Enterprise Programme. The published figure is 0.00 USD on both the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme, so no charge is made for it on either.

## Points of judgement

**Two travellers on one programme each need the visa and documentation service.** The published figure is per traveller, so it stands twice: on a Business Pro Programme, 75.00 USD for each of them.

**A company on the Business Enterprise Plus Programme asks for a report outside the standard suite.** The published figure for that tier is 0.00 USD.
